svg.aria-label: Sixty-six squares, one per verification gate, light up in a wave. All of them are reached by the hosted CI workflow on Ubuntu. The caption cycles through what they cause: processes killed during commits, lost replies, concurrent writers, failed schema upgrades, and restore into empty storage.
